config.local_kernel: sequential fused chain: exact products, one rounding per term, start +0
config.ideal: exact sum of the P FP32 partials rounded once to the output format
config.recovered_fraction: (err_bf16 - err_policy) / (err_bf16 - err_ideal), errors against exact; null when err_bf16 <= err_ideal
config.vs_bf16_exact_gather_note: same ratio with bf16 exact-gather as the target; it can exceed 1 because bf16 exact-gather rounds each FP32 partial to BF16 before its one rounding

phases.reduce_phase: chain reduce to the last rank
all-gather of every input (summed exactly on arrival)

link_model.note: illustrative alpha-beta model; not a measurement
